style: Editorial cookbook food photography. Natural diffused window light from the left, warm tactile surfaces (worn oak, scratched enamel, unglazed stoneware), shallow depth of field, a few honest crumbs and smudges, muted earthy palette with one warm accent. Shot slightly overhead. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logos, no hands holding cutlery mid-air.

images.prompt: A home kitchen counter at golden hour seen three-quarters on: an open fridge door spilling soft light onto a wooden worktop, a shallow bowl of cooked food ready to eat, a stack of glass jars with lentils and rice, a bunch of coriander, a chef knife resting on a board of halved lemons, a small handwritten-looking notebook face down. Lived-in and warm, not styled.

A wide flat-lay of six different finished home-cooked dishes crowded together on a long dark wooden table, as if a group of friends each brought one plate: a curry, a pasta, a grain bowl, a tray of roasted vegetables, flatbreads, and a tart. Overhead, edges of plates overlapping, celebratory and abundant.

Shakshuka in a black cast iron skillet: deep brick-red tomato and pepper stew with four eggs poached into wells, whites just set and yolks glossy orange, torn feta, showered with dill and a dusting of paprika. Charred sourdough on the side.
Thick slice of toasted sourdough piled with glossy dark-caramelised mixed mushrooms in miso butter, glistening, scattered with chives and a crack of black pepper, on a pale speckled ceramic plate.

A stack of three tall pale-golden ricotta hotcakes on a small plate, amber burnt honey running down the sides into a pool, a melting knob of butter on top, a few blackberries and a dusting of lemon zest.

Chilaquiles verdes: tortilla chips coated in bright tomatillo salsa verde in a shallow bowl, still crisp at the edges, topped with crema drizzle, crumbled queso fresco, thin red onion rings, coriander and a fried egg with a runny yolk.

A Vietnamese banh mi cut on the diagonal so the cross-section shows: crackly baguette, caramelised lemongrass pork, pickled carrot and daikon ribbons, cucumber batons, coriander, sliced chilli, on parchment paper.

Cacio e pepe twirled into a nest in a warm shallow white bowl: tonnarelli pasta in a silky pale pecorino sauce clinging to every strand, heavy with coarsely cracked black pepper, a small grater and a wedge of pecorino beside it.

A rice bowl with a lacquered deep-red gochujang glazed salmon fillet, flaking at one edge, over short grain rice, with quick-pickled cucumber, wilted spinach, sesame seeds, spring onion and a soft egg half.

A wide shallow dish of lemony orzo with browned bone-in chicken thighs nestled in it, crisp skin, charred lemon halves, oregano sprigs, wilted spinach and crumbled feta, cooked in a dented enamel roasting tray.

Butter chicken in a copper karahi: deep burnt-orange glossy tomato and cream gravy with tender chunks of tandoori-charred chicken, a swirl of cream, fenugreek leaves crushed over, one green chilli, warm naan torn at the edge of frame.

Thai green curry in a dark bowl: pale jade coconut curry broken with green chilli oil on the surface, wedges of aubergine, pea aubergines, bamboo shoots, torn Thai basil, thin red chilli slivers, a bowl of jasmine rice behind.
Tagliatelle in white ragù: fresh egg ribbons coated in a pale golden-brown pork and veal sauce with no tomato, glossy with butter and stock, heavy shave of parmesan, rosemary, in a wide vintage bowl.

Mapo tofu in a black bowl: cubes of silken white tofu suspended in glossy chilli-red sauce shining with chilli oil, minced pork, fermented black beans, a thick scatter of green spring onion and ground Sichuan pepper, steamed rice alongside.
Coq au vin blanc in a cream enamel Dutch oven: golden braised chicken pieces in a pale silky wine sauce with pearl onions, button mushrooms, lardons and thyme, a ladle resting in the pot.

A Moroccan tagine dish, lid off, holding chickpeas and soft dried apricots in a burnished cumin-and-cinnamon tomato sauce, topped with toasted almonds, coriander and preserved lemon slivers, a bowl of couscous beside it.

A thick Spanish tortilla on a wooden board, one wedge cut out and turned to show the just-set custardy interior full of soft potato and deeply caramelised onion, deep golden crust, coarse salt on top.
A tray of long-stem broccoli charred almost black at the florets, deep green stems, covered in golden anchovy breadcrumbs and lemon zest, chilli flakes, on a battered aluminium baking tray.
Six thick miso chocolate chip cookies on baking paper: craggy ripply golden-brown tops, puddles of dark melted chocolate, flakes of sea salt, one cookie broken open to show the molten middle.

Basbousa semolina cake cut into diamonds in a square tin, deep golden and syrup-soaked, each diamond topped with a whole blanched almond, crushed bright green pistachios and dried rose petals scattered over.

A portion of tiramisu lifted from a glass dish onto a small plate, showing clean layers of coffee-soaked savoiardi and pale mascarpone cream, thick dark cocoa dusting on top, an espresso cup beside it.

A tangle of glossy dark garlic noodles in a well-used wok, coated in soy and butter, flecked with masses of golden fried garlic and green spring onion, chopsticks lifting a small amount, shot late at night under a single warm kitchen light.

Two slices of thick toast under a bubbling blistered layer of melted mozzarella mixed with sweet corn kernels and mayonnaise, browned in patches, sprinkled with parsley and chilli flakes, on a small metal tray.

A glass jar of overnight oats seen from the side: thick pale oats, a swirl of tahini, chopped medjool dates, a spoonful of date syrup pooling on top, toasted sesame and sliced banana, morning light behind the glass.

A whole roasted cauliflower rubbed deep rust-red with harissa, blackened at the tips, sitting on a bed of herbed yoghurt swooshed across a wide plate, with pomegranate seeds, mint and toasted pine nuts.
Very soft small-curd scrambled eggs mounded on a slice of buttered toast on a pale blue plate, custardy and barely set, glistening, with a heavy scatter of fine chives and cracked pepper.
